# maya okafor

> a neighbour who became the partner on the gazebo build, on three apps since 2025-03.

counted from the archive, not written by the model:
- apps: whatsapp (12), telegram (6), instagram (4)

## who they are

a neighbour the owner started writing to in 2025-03 about a permit for a gazebo; by april the two were choosing paint together. [[c:chat_whatsapp_Maya_Okafor]] [[r:MW0]]

## the arc

2025-03: the permit, step by step, almost daily. [[r:MW1]] [[r:MW5]]

2025-04: the talk moves to telegram and to colour; the owner sends options, she picks. [[r:MT0]] [[r:MT3]]

2025-05: photos of the finished frame on instagram, and a wider crew that meets on sundays. [[r:MI0]] [[r:GZ0]]

## promises and debts

- the owner said they would file step 7 of the permit themselves; the archive does not show it filed. [[r:MW7]]

## how the owner writes to them

short, practical, one step per message: "gazebo permit step 3". [[r:MW3]]

my read: this is the one thread where the owner reports progress without being asked. [[r:MW9]] [[r:MW11]]
